normalization_plan.reason: The _mintCount parameter only exists to drive the mint cap, wallet limit and payment checks performed entirely inside mint
The _saleId parameter is only used to index the sales and phases mappings read by mint
The sale local storage pointer is a temporary view of the sales mapping created and consumed solely inside mint
The phase local storage pointer is a temporary view of the phases mapping created and consumed solely inside mint
totalMintsKey is a locally computed hash used only within mint to read and update the totalMints mapping
The _merkleProof parameter is passed directly from mint into onPhaseMintList and has no meaning outside the merkle verification
The _account parameter is only hashed into the merkle leaf built by onPhaseMintList for proof verification
